tests.name: Input Isolation Test
tests.pass_condition: C_orient output is produced using only χ_D, 𝒪_adm(χ_D), and -(i)_k assignments.

tests.name: Topology Blindness Test
tests.pass_condition: C_orient is invariant when T_class labels are withheld, removed, or permuted.

tests.name: Closure Stability Blindness Test
tests.pass_condition: C_orient is invariant when S_closure outputs are withheld, removed, or permuted.

tests.name: Orientation Shuffling Sensitivity Test
tests.pass_condition: Shuffled orientation assignments lower or decorrelate C_orient under matched χ_D.
